dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/7] Youth were excluded if they met DSM-IV criteria for a current mood disorder.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/5] Index parents were administered the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV axis I disorders (SCID-I)21 to assess current mood disorder diagnoses; [/page/3/Text/5] The Schedule for Affective Disorders and Schizophrenia for School-Age Children, Epidemiological Version (K-SADS-PL)22 was administered to parents and adolescents; [/page/3/Text/6] At each follow-up evaluation, parents and adolescents were interviewed about the teen with the Longitudinal Interval Follow-up Evaluation (LIFE),24; [/page/3/Text/6] Interviewers also completed the 17-item Children's Depression Rating Scale–Revised (CDRS-R)25 based on parent and youth report; [/page/3/Text/7] The CES-D19 is a self-report measure of the frequency of 20 depressive symptoms during the past week. It has good psychometric properties when used with adolescents.26 Internal consistency of the CES-D for youth report in this sample was α=.89.; [/page/3/Text/8] The Child and Adolescent Services Assessment (CASA)28 measured mental health service use

MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/5] Index parents were administered the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV axis I disorders (SCID-I)21 to assess current mood disorder diagnoses; [/page/3/Text/5] The Schedule for Affective Disorders and Schizophrenia for School-Age Children, Epidemiological Version (K-SADS-PL)22 was administered to parents and adolescents to obtain youth diagnoses according to the DSM-IV.; [/page/3/Text/6] The primary outcome measure used in the current study was a probable or definite episode of depression (ie, a DSR score≥4) for at least 2 weeks.; [/page/3/Text/6] Interviewers also completed the 17-item Children's Depression Rating Scale–Revised (CDRS-R)25 based on parent and youth report about the adolescents' depressive symptoms in the past 2 weeks.; [/page/3/Text/7] The CES-D19 is a self-report measure of the frequency of 20 depressive symptoms during the past week.
